svg.title: Three-Generation Data & Network Flow Evolution: Naive S3 to Tuned Non-CAS to Shared CAS
svg.desc: Dark-mode architectural flow diagram comparing network and storage paths across three generations of a 30 TB/day ClickHouse cluster: Gen 1 spills unmerged wide parts across 10 per-replica S3 prefixes; Gen 2 fixes 500 MB/s gp3 local merges but still streams TCP :9010 peer copies and writes R duplicate cold S3 prefixes; Gen 3 writes cold parts once (1.00x) via the free S3 Gateway Endpoint into a shared XXH3-128 CAS pool while elastic readers relink by hash in 2.3-3.5s.
svg.text: Three Generations of a 30 TB/Day ClickHouse Fleet — Data & Network Flow
Follow the cold-part path across each generation: TCP :9010 Peer Traffic vs. $0/GB S3 Gateway Endpoint vs. R× S3 Storage Amplification

g.text: S3 Cold Tier: 10 Isolated Per-Replica Prefixes (10×)
Fleet S3 API storm: ~$350–$1,200+/mo · 1.2 TB = 11.99 TB in S3
✗ Stalled on AWS default 125 MB/s gp3 bandwidth wall
✗ 10–15× S3 PUT amplification from premature wide spills
✗ Single-Keeper reboots flipped entire cluster read-only
── Free S3 Gateway Endpoint ($0/GB, 1× PUT per Replica) ──
S3 Cold Tier: Clean APIs, Still R× Isolated Copies
✓ Fleet cold S3 APIs cut to ~$15–$45/mo (compact + TTL drop)
⚠ 9 replicas still store 33.03 GiB for one 3.67 GiB part (9×)
✓ S3 Versioning works · Isolated blast radius per {replica}/
⚠ Scale-out reader re-downloads & re-uploads full cold table
✓ 100% GA upstream LTS · 0 failed batches · 0 read-only events
✓ Survived mid-soak ASG rolling instance replacement cleanly
• Ceiling: R× cold storage tax + Single-AZ compute lock-in
Best Fit: <2–5 TB/day, R ≤ 3, strict LTS / Versioning
GEN 3: SHARED CAS POOL (ANTALYA + CHINIT v0.2.3+)
✓ Cross-AZ cold reads = $0/GB · Keepers off GC path
⚠ Experimental Antalya 26.6 · Unversioned shared blast radius
✓ Isolated backup-0 wakes 02:00 UTC → separate backup bucket
✓ Scale Spot readers 1 → 10+ with $0 extra cold S3 bytes
✓ 7s restarts + clean fresh-EBS rolls via 36B UUID contract
• Trade-off: Hot CPU/RAM unchanged; requires nightly DR backup
33d Cold S3 @ ANY R: $1,436 / mo flat (1×)
Best Fit: 10–100+ TB/day, R ≥ 4, BYOC / Multi-AZ

svg.text: 1× Shared CAS Blob PUT ($0/GB Gateway Endpoint)
2.3–3.5s HEAD Relink + Lazy $0/GB Cross-AZ S3 Read
